daily_report_items: CSIQ security review succeeded: Q2 storage shipments beat guidance, but weaker module economics, wider losses, continued cash use, higher debt and delayed project sales make the 12.86% monthly decline and lower-band breach a risk signal. The USD 13.14 mark improves scenario returns and clears the USD 14.624 buy-below price, but the assessment remains Watch and allocation-ineligible while its causal relationship review is pending; no paper order was created.

evidence.claim: Canadian Solar reported Q2 2026 revenue of USD 1.2 billion, 13.9% gross margin, a USD 77 million attributable loss, negative USD 181 million quarterly operating cash flow, USD 7.1 billion total debt, strong storage shipments and delayed Recurrent Energy project sales.
The SEC submissions index identifies the August 27, 2026 Form 6-K containing Q2 results as Canadian Solar's newest filing through the assessment check.

The canonical alert measured a 12.8647% adjusted-close decline from 2026-07-31 through 2026-08-28, ending at USD 13.140000343322754 below the USD 13.41853735 lower Bollinger band, with RSI 35.62 and negative MACD.

Immutable assessment assessment_3314317f74b3b3f3acc6 links predecessor assessment_a4a0ea4ee734302b6c40 and deterministically derives 26.7694% expected return, 20.0771% confidence-adjusted expected return, USD 14.624 buy-below price, Buy / Initiate, watch conviction and relationship_pending as the eligibility reason.

The bounded candidate relationship review already exists as ready operation 01M0F7V8D8MTRZGEVET3HTD4AT, so this repeat review did not enqueue a duplicate. The payload named no idea and canonical relationships contain no accepted edge for this security, so no idea refresh was required.

summary: Completed the repeat assessment of Canadian Solar Inc. common shares after the 2026-08-28 lower-Bollinger-band alert. Registered the current SEC filing index and Q2 2026 issuer results, updated the security research page and structured security row, and appended schema-v2 assessment assessment_3314317f74b3b3f3acc6 linked to its predecessor. Q2 storage execution was strong, but module contraction, normalized margin, wider losses, working-capital cash use, higher debt and delayed project sales make the decline a risk signal rather than a verified temporary dislocation. At USD 13.14, the deterministic assessment derives USD 10.16/USD 18.28/USD 26.41 bear/base/bull values, Buy / Initiate at watch conviction, and allocation ineligibility because the canonical relationship remains pending. No strategy, signal, order, allocation, execution, cash, portfolio, fill, or performance state changed.
